# Issue templates — human and agent entry

**Parent:** [GitHub interface](../README.md) · **Status:** one proposed `discussion.yml` issue form; more templates require separately justified design.

- [discussion.yml](discussion.yml) — initial shared discussion/notice/objection. Does not require the submitter to know the destination department.
- [Forum](../../forum/README.md) — participation instructions and current limitations.

**Maintenance:** Test rendering in GitHub UI and supported agent tools; permit a blank Issue for unanticipated requests, record broken or unhelpful form fields, and preserve all submissions and dissent.
